26-0364.description: Registration and Elections would use a statewide contract with Abacus Corporation (Morrow, GA) for temporary clerical staff for the 2026 general/nonpartisan election and runoff elections. The contract would cost up to $8.96 million and run from July 1 through December 31, 2026. Pricing sheets cover temporary workers such as registration clerks, couriers and advance voting clerks for the November 3 general election and the December 1 runoff.
26-0364.whyItMayMatter: Temporary workers hired under this contract would help staff voter registration, advance voting and election logistics for Fulton County voters in November and December 2026.

26-0371.description: This resolution would let $500,000 of Fulton County's share of Westside Tax Allocation District (TAD) money be granted to the Andrew J. Young Foundation for site preparation for the Andrew Young International Institute for Peace and Reconciliation in Vine City. The institute is a planned 80,000-square-foot cultural and educational center next to Rodney Cook Sr. Park, with a total budget of $100 million. This site preparation phase costs $2,510,765, and the foundation has a 100-year, $1-a-year ground lease from the City of Atlanta.
26-0371.whyItMayMatter: Vine City would see site work begin for a planned institute that the resolution says will offer free public hours, event space and educational programs.
